results.title: EU, Philippines conduct second security and defense dialogue | Business Mirror - newspaper - Read this story on Magzter.com
results.snippet:
October 29, 2026

THE European Union and the Philippines recently held their second Security and Defense Dialogue in Manila.

-

During the dialogue on October 8, both parties reaffirmed their shared commitment to enhancing alignment on multilateral fora to uphold the rules-based international order.
